findings.mechanism: 06-finding-n-plus-1 – N+1 query pattern: one SELECT for shipments plus a per‑shipment SELECT for courier name, causing queries scaling with result set.
findings.remediation: Replace per‑shipment name_for calls with a single batch query (e.g., join Shipment to Courier or fetch all needed courier names in one IN query) to eliminate N+1 queries.
findings.arithmetic: queries = 1 (shipment list) + N (courier lookups); with N=40 shipments this yields 41 queries per request.
